description.value:
Frequency at will

Requirement Marked quarry at or below half its maximum Hit Points

Your Strike deals an extra 4d8 precision damage instead of your normal precision bonus, and this damage ignores that creature's resistance to precision damage.

cinderfall.incomplete: CORRECTION to this card's own prior note: it claimed "pf2e has no native bloodied/half-HP tracked roll option to predicate against" -- that was wrong. pf2e sets hp-percent:<N> on every actor (pf2e-source/src/module/actor/helpers.ts:167, setHitPointsRollOptions, called for characters and NPCs alike), and pf2e's predicate system supports numeric comparisons against it (src/module/system/predication.ts:64-101, {"lte": ["target:hp-percent", 50]}). Built: the 4d8 precision DamageDice, gated on target:mark:quarry AND target at-or-below-half-HP. NOT built: "ignores that creature's resistance to precision damage" -- confirmed no rule element sets this (pf2e-source's own resistance-ignore mechanism, roll.options.bypass.resistance.ignore in src/module/system/damage/iwr.ts, is populated only by the player's manual roll-dialog toggle, never by a rule element), so this stays player-adjudicated at the roll dialog, matching real pf2e's own convention. Also unaddressed: this bonus is meant to replace, not stack with, Deadeye's own (still-unbuilt, owner-pending) precision bonus -- revisit for a mutual-exclusion predicate once Deadeye's numbers land.
